name: Conventions board: seeded candidates, reject persistence, skill creation
description: Open the Conventions page from the SKILLS LAB sidebar and confirm the seeded candidate board renders (pending card with rule, evidence path:line, confidence %, and the code-counted matching-files figure). Exercise the triage flow over seeded data only — the scan buttons are NEVER clicked, so no model call happens: open the Create-skill modal (server draft merges the one accepted convention) and cancel; reject the pending candidate and prove the decision survives a reload under the All filter; then create the repo-conventions skill through the modal and confirm it lands on the Skills page. Locators rely on DOM order where names overlap: the modal's Create submit renders before the toolbar's Create skill in the DOM, the All chip renders before Deselect all, and the default Pending filter shows exactly one Reject button. MUTATES seeded data (one reject, one skill create) — needs the hermetic runner's fresh DB; a second run against the same stack would 409 on the duplicate skill name.
